evidence.commitSubject: fix: set inactivity-alerts cron to */30 schedule; add unit test
evidence.changesSummary: vercel.json: inactivity-alerts cron changed from daily (0 9 * * *) to every-30-min (*/30 * * * *); duplicate inactivity-check entry removed. Adds 288-line unit test covering dedup, dry-run, and alert paths.
evidence.mainCurrentState: vercel.json on main still has daily schedule (0 9 * * *) AND duplicate inactivity-check entry — this fix was never merged

relatedPRs.title: Dev: fix-inactivity-alerting-cron-not-implemented
relatedPRs.note: Older PR for initial cron implementation — different from this schedule correction

riskRationale: Only changes vercel.json cron schedule (config, not code logic) and adds a new test file. No business logic, no database changes, no API changes. Aligns with FR-5 requirement (every 30 min). The duplicate inactivity-check removal is safe cleanup.
recommendation: Create a task and PR for this branch. The fix is valid, small, and self-contained. Main currently has the wrong schedule (daily instead of every 30 min) and a duplicate cron entry. Should be shipped.
